title: Compatible local data for gluing a perfect pullback comparison
statement: Let g:X\to Y be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with shared derived module categories on all schemes and localized open sites [def-pc-derived-category], and E\in D(\mathcal O_X). Define PerfectOpenGluingData(g,E) to assert the existence of opens U,V covering Y, an adjunction Lg^*\dashv Rg_* [def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-direct-image], and natural restriction/pullback comparisons \gamma_U:Lg^*\circ R_U^X\cong R_U^Y\circ L(g|_U)^* and \gamma_V of the same form, where R_U^X restricts to g^{-1}U and R_U^Y restricts to U [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. There are perfect A\in D(\mathcal O_U) and B\in D(\mathcal O_V) [def-pc-perfect-complex], an overlap isomorphism e:A|_{U\cap V}\cong B|_{U\cap V}, and maps a:A\to R_U^Y(Rg_*E), b:B\to R_V^Y(Rg_*E). With the canonical nested-open composition comparisons, a|_{U\cap V}=e followed by b|_{U\cap V}. Both maps L(g|_U)^*(a) followed by \gamma_U^{-1}(Rg_*E) and then R_U^X(\epsilon_E), and its V analogue, are invertible; \epsilon is the supplied adjunction's counit. This predicate has only local objects and maps, and asserts no global object on Y.

lean.statement:
def PerfectOpenGluingData {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y)
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (U : Z.Opens),
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) : Prop
